name: marsana-launcher-mobile
description: Marsana Launcher — mobil Bedrock başlatıcı (Android + iOS)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:win: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
